w: Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha of a canvas painting of murtis of the guru parampara at the Swaminarayan Mandir in Vadu.
28 April, 2000 (Chaitra Vad 9, VS 2056) Purushottampura In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored.

Swamishri performed the rituals of the 21st patotsav (inauguratiion anniversary) of Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir. The murti of Shastriji Maharaj was adorned with flowers and annakut was arranged. Swamishri performed the patotsav arti and finally blessed the assembly.
At 5.45 p.m. Pujya Viveksagar Swami inaugurated a primary health care center 'Pramukh Swami Prathmik Arogya Kendra' in the mandir precincts.

In the evening assembly, the main features of this year's agenda under the auspicies of the Golden Anniversary Celebration of BAPS Bal Mandal was enacted on stage. Then Swamishri blessed the assembly.
If you want to be good then see that which is good, think that which is good and form a habit of imbibing that which is good. (24 April 03)

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
Devotees from all suburbs of Bhavnagar fasted 83 hours for Swamishri's good health.
Eight devotees pilgrimaged on foot, covering a distance of 28 kms from the village of Sihor.
83 kishores fasted today to please Swamishri.

After his morning puja Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Ghanshyam Maharaj, Guru Parampara, Radha-Krishna Dev, Sita-Ram, Shiv-Parvati, Hanumanji and Ganapati for the hari mandirs in the Amdavad suburbs of Maninagar and Nava Vadaj. Swamishri also performed the foundation- stone laying rituals of three new hari mandirs to be built in the suburbs of Nirnaynagar, Nikol and Chandlodia. At 11.00 am Swamishri honoured the renowned Sanskrit pundit of Gujarat Shri K. Ka. Shastri who had completed 100 years with a garland and shawl.

To Celebrate The Centenary of Bochasan Mandir a maha abhishek was arranged today. Yesterday morning the yagna for the maha abhishek was performed, and from 5.00 pm to 7.00 pm senior sadhus and devotees completed the rituals of kalash sthapan of 1000 kalashes under a canopy set up by the mandir steps. The 1000 kalashes contained water of rivers, lakes and wells sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

Today, Swamishri performed the maha abhishek arti of Thakorji in the central shrine. Thereafter the maha abhishek rituals, in which 1000 devotees had participated, continued while Swamishri performed his puja on the nearby school grounds of Swaminarayan Vidya Mandir.

When Swamishri arrived for the maha abhishek in the mandir sanctum, mantras were chanted by Brahmin pandits. Swamishri performed abhishek of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj and other murtis with saffron water. Thereafter Swamishri performed abhishek on the utsav murti of Maharaj and a little murti of Thakorji, and its water was channelized towards the main sanctum and released in a shower upon the main murtis. Thereafter the devotees performed the abhishek. Then Swamishri performed abhishek of the gurus in the guru shikhars. At 10.00 am Swamishri arrived for the festival assembly that had commenced after his puja. Satyaprakash Swami had spoken about the history of Bochasan Mandir, Brahmadarshan Swarmi discoursed about Akshar-Purushottam upasana, Dr Swami explained what one should do to celebrate BAPS the centenary year and Mahant Swami spoke about God’s power and the development of BAPS through piety. Thereafter Swamishri performed abhishek of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj so that all could have darshan in the assembly. Then the senior sadhus honoured Swamishri with garlands. Then 158 kishores performed a traditional dance on the bhajan, “Akshar-Purushottam na danka digantma sambhalay chhe.” Finally, Swamishri blessed the festival assembly, “One is blessed with merits by the mere darshan of this festival. One also gets the same merits by serving physically and mentally appreciating the festival to be divine. “Akshar Purushottam Maharaj was first consecrated here in Bochasan. On the occasion of its centenary celebration the murtis were ritually re-secrated (punah pratishtha). It is not that the pratishtha of God’s murti is done again because it has lost its divinity. God never loses his divinity and powers. If his power dwindles then we would become drained of strength. We perform this festival (of patotsav) to reinstate our own strength lost due to our lapses.

“Whatever glory we have of God will be useful to us. God’s power is infinite. By having faith in God’s powers one’s life’s works will be accomplished. Offering devotion, service and upasana to him with an understanding of his glory one attains Akshardham. One cannot achieve this through austerity, donation, pilgrimage and other means. The glory of such means has been written in the shastras. The pilgrim places have also been extolled in the shastras but their greatness is due to God. God is a maha-tirth. All pilgrim places are included in God and his sadhu. When one understands God’s glory in one’s soul then one attains the highest fruit (of Akshardham).”

ds.t: Rebukes will have to be borne
w: Following his daily routine, when Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to Yogiji Maharaj's room for darshan, a parshad recited a saying of Yogiji Maharaj: "I bore my guru's rebukes a great deal. I bore rebukes for forty years, so now I have got used to bearing them."
"How many years?" Swamishri asked.
"Forty years," everyone replied.
Swamishri said, "That's it, then do not worry until then. Rebukes will have to be borne."
Swamishri gave everyone a wonderful formula for spiritual practice.

2009.o: Pratishtha of Nilkanth Varni and Guru Parampara Murtis Monday
w: At 7.30 a.m., prior to his morning puja, Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of Nilkanth Varni and Guru Parampara murtis in the Varni mandapam . The pre-rituals of pratishtha were performed by Kothari Swami and Tyagvallabh Swami. Over 140 devotees participated in the mahapuja rituals. The final rituals were performed in Swamishri’s presence. Swamishri performed the consecration rituals of Nilkanth Varni and the senior sadhus performed the rituals of the murtis of Guru Parampara. Then Swamishri and senior sadhus performed pujan and arti of the murtis . Swamishri then performed the first abhishek of Nilkanth Varni. Thereafter the holy water was sprinkled upon all the devotees. Swamishri arrived for Thakorji’s darshan in the mandir. An annakut was arranged before Thakorji in all the three shrines. After completing his morning puja in the Yogi Mandapam Swamishri blessed all, “Today is a day of immense joy and celebration because Nilkanth Varni has been consecrated. We pray that the wishes of whosoever does darshan of Nilkanth Varni and performs his abhishek be fulfilled. All of you have offered great service for this occasion and the sadhus too have put in a lot of effort, so may God fulfil your wishes. May Maharaj liberate your 71 generations, make you happy and grant you with peace of mind.”
Shrutiprakash Swami spoke about the various kinds of yoga. Looking at Atmasantosh Swami, who was sitting for darshan, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Which yoga are you practising?"
He said, "Your yoga (union with you), the greatest of all."
Smiling gently and meaningfully, Swamishri said, "Short and sweet."
Shrutiprakash Swami spoke about the various types of yoga. Looking at Atmasantosh Swami, who was sitting for darshan, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Which yoga is going on for you?"
He said, "Your yoga (union), the greatest of all."
Smiling meaningfully and gently, Swamishri said, "Short and sweet."
